themes_detail.label: Consumer Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Consumer complaints spiked 96% THIS WEEK to 14 cases versus a baseline of 7.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting either a new retail or service issue affecting residents or an emerging pattern of fraud/deceptive practices in the district.
evidence: 14 consumer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (96% spike)
Z-score of 8.81 indicates statistically anomalous spike
No corroborating Reddit discussions or local news mentions yet, suggesting story is breaking
reporting_angles: Identify the specific retail/service businesses or categories generating complaints—cannabis retailers, unlicensed vendors, or online scams targeting local residents?
Interview affected consumers about what went wrong and whether city agencies are responding

themes_detail.label: Animal Abuse Reports Escalate
themes_detail.summary: Animal abuse complaints jumped 250% LAST WEEK to 7 cases versus a baseline of 2.0 per week, indicating a potential cluster of animal neglect, fighting, or abandonment incidents in the district.
evidence: 7 animal abuse complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.0 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (250% spike)
No Reddit or news coverage yet, suggesting early-stage story opportunity
reporting_angles: Work with ASPCA or local animal control to identify whether incidents cluster geographically (e.g., specific blocks, parks) and whether they involve similar circumstances
Interview residents and advocates about whether this reflects increased awareness/reporting or actual increase in abuse

themes_detail.label: Flooring & Stairway Hazards
themes_detail.summary: Flooring and stairway complaints jumped 260% LAST WEEK to 9 cases versus a baseline of 2.5 per week, suggesting deteriorating building conditions in residential stock, possibly concentrated in older multi-family units in Brighton Beach or Coney Island.
evidence: 9 flooring/stairway complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (260% spike)
Z-score of 4.6 indicates high statistical significance
204 DOB alteration permits filed in past 90 days, suggesting potential remediation work may be ongoing or inadequate
reporting_angles: Cross-reference complaints geographically—are they concentrated in rent-stabilized buildings or specific landlords with patterns of neglect?
Interview residents about injury risk and landlord responsiveness to repair requests

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Violations
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints spiked 500% TWO WEEKS AGO to 3 cases versus a baseline of 0.5 per week, indicating potential unlicensed operators, zoning violations, or local quality-of-life conflicts as the cannabis retail market expands in the district.
evidence: 3 cannabis retailer complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (500% spike)
Potential regulatory gap: SCA and DOH oversight of unlicensed operators may be lagging demand
reporting_angles: Map licensed vs. unlicensed cannabis retailers in CD313; identify whether spike relates to illicit shops or complaints about legal retailers
Interview SCA and community board about enforcement capacity and local zoning rules

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees & Street Hazards
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints surged 540% TWO WEEKS AGO to 4 cases versus a baseline of 0.6 per week, suggesting seasonal growth compounded by possible Parks Department maintenance gaps heading into summer.
evidence: 4 overgrown tree complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (540% spike)
Timing aligns with spring/early summer growth cycle
reporting_angles: Check Parks Department work orders and budget allocation for tree maintenance in CD313 for current fiscal year
Identify whether complaints concentrate near parks (Coney Island Beach, Seaside Park) or residential streets
